create_container_instance: create a single container instance with a definition, command, and optional environment variables
create_multiple_container_instances: create multiple container instances with a list of commands and per-instance environment variables
get_container_instance: get a container instance by its instance ID and return the PCS container instance
cancel_container_instance: cancel a running container instance by its instance ID
get_current_instances_count: get the current count of active container instances in the cluster
